content: Birappe Oosettida Zayeta
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Dereza issi bolla shiishshanaas gidiin woykko asay dunkaani dizasoppe denththeththanaas punniza nam7u zayeta birappe qoxxa kessa.
Nam7u zayeti punettiza wode kumeththa maabaray Gaytoteththa Dunkaaneza pengen ne dizaso shiiqo.
Issi zayey zayettiza wode gidikko Isra7eele asaappe korapinneti xalla neekko shiiqetto.
Zayeza dhoqqu histti zaykko arshey mokkiza baggara dunkaani uttida asay koyro hemeth doommo.
Ne zayeza nam7anththo dhoqqu histta punniza wode dugeha baggara dunkaani uttida asay hemeth doommo; zayey dhoqqu gi zayetiza wode asay hemeth doommanaas malata gido.
Deraa issi bolla shiishshanaas zayeta dhoqqisontta ziqqi histta zaya.
Qeese gidida Aaroone nayti zayeta punnetto; hessika inttes naa naa gakkanaas eqqi diza woga gido.
«Intte deraa bolla worajjida intte morkketara intte olettanaas keziza wode zayeta dhoqqu histti punnite; histtiko GODAA intte Xoossay inttena qoppananne intte morkketappe inttena ashshana.

Hessaththoka intte ufayssa ba7aale gallas, hessika agina ba7aaletanne dumma dumma intte bonchchanaas qachchida ba7aaleta bonchchiza wode xuugettiza yarshonne issifeteththa yarshota shiishshiza wode zayeta punnite; heyti Xoossa sinththan inttena qofsana; tani GODAA intte Xoossaa.»
Siinappe Isra7eele Asaa Buus
Derezi Gibxe dereppe kezida nam7anththo layththan nam7anththo aginay gelida nam7u tammanththo gallas Markkateththa Dunkaanezappe bollara diza shaarazi dendides.
Isra7eele asay Siina bazzofe dendidi shaarazi Paaraane bazzon eqqana gakkanaas dumma dummason shempida.
Isra7eele asay GODAY kase Muse azazida azazoza mala koyro yuusho hemeth doommides.
Yuhuda qommota bandira garsan diza Aminadaabe naa Ne7asooney kaaleththiin ba butte tara naagidi koyro bida.
Yisakoore zarkketa kaaleththizay Xu7aare naa Natina7eele.
Zaabiloone zarkketa kaaleththizay Heloone naa Elyaabe.
Hessafe guye dunkaanezi shodettiin Dunkaaneza tookkidayti Gershoone qommotinne Meraare zarkketi buus doommida.
Istta kaallidi Oroobeele zarkketa bandira garsan dizayti Shaadure naa Elxuurey kaaleththiin ba tara naagidi bida.
Simoona zarkketa kaaleththizay Xurshadaye naa Salum7eele.
Gaade zarkketa kaaleththizay Da7u7eele naa Elyaasaafe.
Hessafe guye Lewe bagga as gidida Qa7aate zarkke gididayti geeshsha miishshata tookki ekkidi bida; istti baappe sinththa baggan diza heeraza gakkanaappe kase Xoossa dunkaanezi toletti uttees.
Hessafe kaallidi Efreeme zarkketa bandira garsan dizayti Amihuude naa Elshamay kaaleththiin ba tara naagidi bida.
Minaase zarkketa kaaleththizay Pedaxuure naa Gamal7eele.
Biniyaame zarkketa kaaleththizay Gidi7oone naa Abidaane.
Wurseththan ha butteta guye tuchchan naagiza Daane zarkketa bandira garsan dizayti ba tara naagidi bida; Daane qommota kaaleththizay Amishadaye naa Ahi7ezeere.
Aaseere zarkketa kaaleththizay Okra naa Fagu7eele;
Niftaaleme zarkketa kaaleththizay Enaane naa Ahire.
Hessa gishshas Isra7eele asay kase ba dizasoppe kezidi ba butten butten biza buussaa maaray hayssa mala.

Musey ba machchey aawa Midiyaame dere as Era7u7eele naa Hobaabes, «Hekko nuni GODAY nuus immanaas kase caaqqida dere baanaas giigettidos; GODAY Isra7eele asaa duresanaas kase nuus caaqqi woththides; hessa gishshas nekka nunara hedhdha; nuni nees lo7o ooththana» gides.
Hobaabey, «Akkay! Kase tani yelettida derenne ta dabbotakko simma baana» gides.
Musey izas, «Ne nuuppe shaaketta booparkkii! Nuni hayssa bazzo biittan bishe awan awan shempana bessizaakko neni eraasa; neni nuna oge kaaleththiza as gidana.
Neni nunara biikko GODAY nuus immiza lo7o miishsha ubbaafe nu nees shaakki immana» gides.

Derezi geeshsha zumay diza Siina bazzo yeggidi heedzdzu gallassa oge bides; heedzdzu gallassatan GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotazi asay shempanaaso koyanaas asappe sinththati bides; istti kase ba diza heeraa yeddanaappe kasetidi asay shempanaaso koyanaas Caaqo Qaalaa Taabotazi isttafe sinththan sinththan bides.
Istti ba dizasoppe dendi dendi bishin GODAA shaaray gallas gallas istta kammi oykkees.
Caaqo Qaalaa Taabotay baana dendishin dendishin Musey, «GODAWU! Nekka denda; ne morkketi laalettetto; nena ixxizayti wurikka ne sinththafe kichchetto!» gees.
Caaqo Qaala Taabotazi issiso gakki eqqiza wode, «Ta GODAWU! Daro shiyan qoodettiza Isra7eele asaakko ne ayfeso haa zaara» gees.
